title: Tie Fighter
description: TIE fighters were the vanguard of the Imperial Fleet, iconic in their profile and easily recognizable by sight or sound across the galaxy. They were an unforgettable symbol of the Empire. With no shields or hyperdrives, they were fast, single-pilot fighters designed to go toe-to-toe with Rebel starfighters. The familiar roar of their twin ion engines was enough to strike fear in the hearts of any who opposed a TIE fighter in mortal combat.
